# RL Lab — Architecture

**Status:** Draft · **Shape:** Single package · **Last updated:** 2026-10-17 · **Spec:** [spec.md](spec.md)

Single package (`rllab`): one learner, one laptop, one install, nothing deployed. The one seam that could become its own package is `refcheck`, the only component that carries Stable-Baselines3 and Gymnasium. It sits behind an optional `check` extra, so a split would move it out as it is.

## Overview
Every world implements one multi-agent `World` protocol (AD-04): it resets from a seed, steps on one action array for all agents, and reports per-team scores and a drawable state. `train` drives a hand-written learner per team (AD-03) over a world for a fixed step budget. It plays held-out evaluation episodes through `core.play_episode` and writes everything to a run folder through `runlog` (AD-06). `evaluate` replays final checkpoints and both baselines on the final seeds and runs the paired permutation test. `charts` draws learning curves from run folders. `replay` re-simulates any checkpoint or baseline from a seed into a `Trace`, then shows it in a pygame window or writes it to MP4 (AD-07). `refcheck` trains Stable-Baselines3 on the same world through an adapter, kept away from every training run (AD-08).

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  cli --> train & evaluate & charts & replay & refcheck & notes
  train --> methods & runlog & worlds & baselines
  evaluate --> methods & runlog & worlds & baselines
  replay --> methods & runlog & worlds & baselines
  refcheck --> evaluate & train & worlds
  charts --> runlog & evaluate
  methods --> runlog
  worlds & baselines & methods & runlog --> core
```

## Tech stack
| Area | Choice | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| Language, env | Python 3.12, uv, one `pyproject.toml` | AD-01 |
| Networks, autograd | PyTorch ≥ 2.5, CPU wheels; `nn` layers and `optim` only | AD-02 |
| Numerics, world physics | NumPy ≥ 2.1, vectorised over agents | AD-04 |
| Learning methods | Hand-written DQN (discrete) and PPO (continuous), one learner per team | AD-03 |
| Seeds, parallel runs | `np.random.SeedSequence`, one spawned process per run | AD-05 |
| Run storage | JSON record + JSON Lines logs + `torch.save` checkpoints per run folder | AD-06 |
| Replay window, video | pygame-ce ≥ 2.5; imageio ≥ 2.36 with imageio-ffmpeg ≥ 0.5 (bundled ffmpeg) | AD-07 |
| Charts | matplotlib ≥ 3.9, PNG + SVG | — |
| Reference check | stable-baselines3 ≥ 2.4 + gymnasium ≥ 1.0, optional extra `check` | AD-08 |
| Settings | TOML files in `configs/`, read with `tomllib` into frozen dataclasses | — |
| CLI | `argparse`, one `rllab` console script | — |
| Tests, import rules | pytest; import-linter | — |

## Components
| Component | Responsibility | Covers | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|
| `core` | World and policy protocols, shared types, held-out seed sets, and the one episode loop every other component plays through | WORLD-01–WORLD-07 (interface), WORLD edge cases | — |
| `worlds` | Snake, the three fish-tank variants, predator-prey and the two check worlds, behind `worlds.make` | SNAKE-01–SNAKE-06, FISH-01–FISH-08, PREY-01–PREY-06, TRAIN-06 (check worlds) | `core` |
| `baselines` | Random play for any action format, and each world's hand-written rule acting on observations only | EVAL-01, EVAL-02, SNAKE-07, FISH-09, PREY-07 | `core`, `worlds` |
| `methods` | Hand-written DQN and PPO learners behind `Learner`; rebuilds a frozen `Policy` from a checkpoint | CHECK-01, TRAIN-07 | `core`, `runlog` |
| `train` | One run over the step budget: per-team learners, checkpoints, in-training evaluations, invalid-number stop; batches across cores; the check-world gate | TRAIN-01–TRAIN-07, QR-01–QR-03, TRAIN edge cases | `core`, `worlds`, `baselines`, `methods`, `runlog` |
| `runlog` | Run folders: record, episode and evaluation logs, checkpoints, live progress, run lookup | LOG-01, LOG-02, LOG-06, TRAIN-03 (storage), TRAIN edge cases (overwrite, incomplete) | `core` |
| `charts` | Learning curves with range bands and baseline lines, extra measures, two-team curves, pairing heatmaps; follows the `dataviz` skill | LOG-03–LOG-05, PREY-10, PREY-09 (chart), LOG edge cases | `runlog`, `evaluate` |
| `evaluate` | Final evaluation on the final seeds, paired permutation tests run with the `null-hypothesis-testing` skill, verdicts, summaries, fixed-opponent team evaluation, pairing grids, collapse flags | EVAL-03–EVAL-06, SNAKE-08, FISH-10, PREY-08, PREY-09, QR-05, EVAL and PREY edge cases | `core`, `worlds`, `baselines`, `methods`, `runlog` |
| `replay` | Re-simulates checkpoints or baselines into a `Trace`; pygame viewer with pause, step, speeds, side by side and sight overlay; MP4 export | REPLAY-01–REPLAY-08, QR-04, REPLAY edge cases | `core`, `worlds`, `baselines`, `methods`, `runlog` |
| `refcheck` | Trains and evaluates Stable-Baselines3 DQN/PPO on a world through a Gymnasium/VecEnv adapter, and compares with the hand-written summary | CHECK-02, CHECK-03, CHECK edge case | `core`, `worlds`, `train`, `evaluate`, `runlog` |
| `notes` | Write-up scaffold with the three headings only, and the finish check (parts present, struggle link, broken links) | NOTES-01–NOTES-03, NOTES edge case | — |
| `cli` | The `rllab` command: train, batch, watch, chart, evaluate, grid, refcheck, replay, compare, video, notes | LOG-06 (view), REPLAY-01 (entry) | all of the above |

## Interfaces
See [packages/rllab/contract.md](packages/rllab/contract.md).

## Data
No external datasets: every world is simulated. Generated data lives under `runs/<world>/<variant>/<run-name>/` (AD-06):
- `run.json`: the LOG-01 record, the run's config and its status (`running`, `finished`, `incomplete`, `failed` with step and value).
- `episodes.jsonl`: one line per training episode (LOG-02). `evals.jsonl`: one line per 5% evaluation point (TRAIN-04), flushed as written so `rllab watch` reads it live (LOG-06).
- `checkpoints/ckpt_<pct>.pt`: 12 checkpoints (TRAIN-03), each holding the `WorldSpec`, per-team method configs and state dicts.
- Final evaluations under `runs/<world>/<variant>/_eval/<date>/` (`summary.json`, per-episode scores), reference runs under `_reference/`, charts and videos under `reports/<world>/`, write-ups at `notes/<world>.md`.

Seeds come from three disjoint ranges (AD-05): training episode seeds drawn by the run's generator from [0, 10⁶), the 20 in-training evaluation seeds 1,000,000–1,000,019, and the 100 final seeds 2,000,000–2,000,099, shared by every run and baseline.

## Cross-cutting concerns
- **Determinism (WORLD-02, TRAIN-02, REPLAY-02, FISH-11, PREY-11):** no global random state. Each episode seed spawns the world's and the policies' generators, and torch runs single-threaded with deterministic algorithms (AD-05). A committed digest of a short snake run's logs and final checkpoint is checked in CI. A later world that changes it fails the build (FISH-11, PREY-11), and so does a fish digest once S2 lands.
- **No outside RL code in training (CHECK-01):** import-linter forbids `stable_baselines3` and `gymnasium` outside `refcheck`, and a test asserts neither is in `sys.modules` after a training run (AD-08).
- **Speed (QR-01, QR-02, QR-04, QR-05):** world physics is NumPy over all agents at once, learners batch every team's observations into one forward pass, and evaluation spreads seeds over processes. `rllab` logs each run's wall time against the 60-minute budget, and a timing test plays a 1,000-step replay headless.
- **GPU (QR-03):** `device` is a run setting, `cpu` by default; a rented GPU run uses the same code, and its cost goes in the write-up by hand.
- **Offline (QR-06):** nothing imports a network client. ffmpeg comes bundled with imageio-ffmpeg, and fonts come from pygame's built-in one.
- **Errors:** bad actions raise `core.ActionError` naming the agent and value (never clipped). Spec mismatches on checkpoint load raise `methods.SpecMismatchError` naming the field. Mixed-settings charts raise `charts.MixedRunsError` naming the differing settings.
- **Skills:** `charts` follows `dataviz` for every chart (LOG-04). `evaluate.compare` is built and checked with `null-hypothesis-testing`, whose inputs are its signature (EVAL-04).

## Project layout
```
src/rllab/     → core/ worlds/ baselines/ methods/ train/ runlog/ charts/ evaluate/ replay/ refcheck/ notes/ cli/ — one folder per component; __init__ exports its contract
configs/       → one TOML per world and variant: budget, per-team method settings
runs/          → generated run folders (git-ignored)
reports/       → charts and videos kept alongside the write-ups
notes/         → one write-up per world, the learner's own words
tests/         → folders only; files are planned in pipelines.md
```

## Decisions
### AD-01: Python 3.12 in one uv-managed package
**Status:** Proposed · **Date:** 2026-10-17 · **Scope:** system
- **Context:** One learner on an Apple Silicon laptop; PyTorch, pygame-ce and Stable-Baselines3 all ship arm64 macOS wheels for Python. QR-06 needs the whole install to work offline once set up.
- **Decision:** Python 3.12, one `rllab` package with a `uv.lock`. Stable-Baselines3 and Gymnasium go in an optional `check` extra.
- **Alternatives:** Python 3.13: wheels for some libraries lag. Separate `rllab-check` package: a real boundary only if the reference stack becomes a burden, so it is a named seam for now.
- **Consequences:** `requires-python = ">=3.12,<3.13"`. Training can run without the `check` extra installed, which proves CHECK-01 at install level too.

### AD-02: PyTorch for networks and gradients, not for the learning algorithm
**Status:** Proposed · **Date:** 2026-10-17 · **Scope:** system
- **Context:** CHECK-01 allows automatic gradient computation but the learner writes action choice, learning targets and updates. Networks are small MLPs on observations of tens of numbers (WORLD-03). Training is CPU-only (QR-01).

- **Consequences:** `torch.set_num_threads(1)` per run process (AD-05); small batches stay fast on CPU. The PyTorch install is about 200 MB.

### AD-05: Seeds from SeedSequence, disjoint held-out ranges, one process per run
**Status:** Proposed · **Date:** 2026-10-17 · **Scope:** system
- **Context:** WORLD-01, WORLD-02, TRAIN-02 and REPLAY-02 need exact repeats; TRAIN-04 and EVAL-03 need seeds never used in training; TRAIN-05 and QR-02 need runs in parallel, one per core.
- **Decision:** A run seed spawns the learner's, exploration and episode-seed generators through `np.random.SeedSequence`. - **Consequences:** Identical runs are promised on the same machine only (TRAIN-02). In-training evaluation never touches the training generators, so turning evaluation off for a test leaves training identical.

- **Consequences:** Charts and evaluation read whole JSONL files; at ~10⁴ episodes per run that is instant. A crashed process leaves `run.json` at `running`; `runlog` reports any `running` run with no live process as incomplete.

- **Invariants:** `agents` are indices into the world's agent axis; teams of one world are disjoint and cover every agent

# rllab — Contract

**Package:** rllab · **Status:** Draft · **Last updated:** 2026-10-17 · **Architecture:** [../../architecture.md](../../architecture.md)

`Direction = Literal["higher", "lower"]`, `Settings = Mapping[str, int | float | str | bool]` and `Array = np.ndarray` are used throughout.

## core

### core.ActionSpace: type
`ActionSpace = Discrete(n: int) | Box(dims: int, low: float, high: float)`, both frozen dataclasses
- **Invariants:** `Discrete` actions are ints in `[0, n)`; `Box` actions are `dims` floats in `[low, high]`
- **Boundary:** worlds, baselines, methods, refcheck · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.ActionSpace/ · **Cases:** snake `Discrete(3)`; fish `Box(2, -1.0, 1.0)`
- **Used by:** worlds, baselines, methods, refcheck

### core.TeamSpec: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class TeamSpec: name: str; agents: tuple[int, ...]; score_name: str; direction: Direction`
- **Invariants:** `agents` are indices into the world's agent axis; teams of one world are disjoint and cover every agent
- **Boundary:** worlds, train, evaluate, charts · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.TeamSpec/ · **Cases:** snake's one team; predator-prey's prey (6) and predator (2) teams
- **Used by:** every component reading scores

### core.WorldSpec: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class WorldSpec: world: str; variant: str; agents: tuple[str, ...]; teams: tuple[TeamSpec, ...]; obs_len: int; action: ActionSpace; max_steps: int; measures: tuple[MeasureSpec, ...]; sight: float | None`
`MeasureSpec(name: str, team: str, direction: Direction)`
- **Invariants:** available without running an episode (WORLD-04); `sight` is the radius in world units for local-sight variants, else `None`; equality of two specs is field by field
- **Boundary:** worlds, methods, runlog, replay, refcheck · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.WorldSpec/ · **Cases:** snake default; fish local-sight (8 agents, sight set); predator-prey
- **Used by:** all components

### core.Step: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class Step: obs: Array; rewards: Array; active: Array; done: bool; truncated: bool`
- **Invariants:** `obs` float32 `n_agents × obs_len`; `rewards` float32 `n_agents`; `active` bool `n_agents`, and an inactive agent's row is zeros with reward 0 (WORLD edge case); `truncated` is true only when `max_steps` ended the episode
- **Boundary:** worlds, methods, refcheck · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.Step/ · **Cases:** a snake mid-episode step; a predator-prey step with one prey caught
- **Used by:** core.play_episode, train, refcheck

### core.EpisodeResult: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class EpisodeResult: seed: int; length: int; scores: Mapping[str, float]; team_rewards: Mapping[str, float]; measures: Mapping[str, float]`
- **Invariants:** `scores` and `team_rewards` keyed by team name (WORLD-05, LOG-02); `measures` keyed by every `MeasureSpec.name`
- **Boundary:** train, runlog, evaluate, refcheck · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.EpisodeResult/ · **Cases:** a snake episode with 12 food; a predator-prey episode with both team scores
- **Used by:** train, runlog, evaluate, refcheck

### core.DrawState: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class DrawState: width: float; height: float; objects: tuple[Drawable, ...]`
`Drawable(kind: str, x: float, y: float, size: float, team: str | None, agent: int | None)`
- **Invariants:** lists every object on screen at that step (WORLD-06); snake cells use grid coordinates with `size` 1; `agent` set for agents, so the viewer can draw `WorldSpec.sight` around them
- **Boundary:** worlds, replay · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.DrawState/ · **Cases:** a snake board; an 8-fish tank with the ball
- **Used by:** replay

### core.Frame: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class Frame: step: int; draw: DrawState; scores: Mapping[str, float]; rewards: Array`
- **Invariants:** `scores` is each team's running score after this step; `rewards` the latest per agent (REPLAY-05); frame 0 is the reset state with zero rewards
- **Boundary:** replay · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.Frame/ · **Cases:** frame 0 and frame 1 of seed 7 snake
- **Used by:** replay

### core.Episode: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class Episode: result: EpisodeResult; frames: tuple[Frame, ...] | None; hit_step_limit: bool`
- **Invariants:** `frames` is set only when traced, with `result.length + 1` entries
- **Boundary:** train, evaluate, replay, refcheck · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.Episode/ · **Cases:** an untraced snake episode; a traced 3-step check-world episode
- **Used by:** train, evaluate, replay, refcheck

### core.World: type
```python
class World(Protocol):
    spec: WorldSpec
    def reset(self, seed: int) -> Step: ...
    def step(self, actions: Array) -> Step: ...
    def result(self) -> EpisodeResult: ...
    def draw(self) -> DrawState: ...
```
- **Invariants:** same seed → same start (WORLD-01); same seed and actions → same steps (WORLD-02); `actions` has one row per agent, rows of inactive agents ignored
- **Errors:** `step` raises `ActionError(agent: str, value: object)`, a `ValueError`, for an action outside `spec.action`, never clipping it; `step` after `done` raises `RuntimeError`
- **Boundary:** train, evaluate, replay, refcheck · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.World/ · **Cases:** a replay double of a recorded 5-step snake episode from seed 42
- **Used by:** every component that plays episodes

### core.Policy: type
`class Policy(Protocol): def act(self, obs: Array, rng: np.random.Generator) -> Array`
- **Invariants:** `obs` is `k × obs_len` for the `k` agents of one team; returns `k` actions inside the world's `ActionSpace`; deterministic for a given `obs` and `rng` state
- **Boundary:** baselines, methods, evaluate, replay, refcheck · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.Policy/ · **Cases:** a replay double of the snake rule policy over 5 observations
- **Used by:** core.play_episode, train, evaluate, replay, refcheck

### core.play_episode: The one episode loop
`def play_episode(world: World, policies: Mapping[str, Policy], seed: int, *, trace: bool = False) -> Episode`
- **Invariants:** `policies` keyed by team; the seed spawns the world's and each policy's generator (AD-05), so the same inputs give the same `Episode`; stops at `done` or `spec.max_steps`
- **Errors:** `KeyError` naming a team with no policy; `ActionError` propagates from `World.step`
- **Boundary:** train, evaluate, replay, refcheck · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.play_episode/ · **Cases:** snake rule policy, seed 7, traced
- **Used by:** train, evaluate, replay, refcheck

### core.EVAL_SEEDS: In-training evaluation seeds
`EVAL_SEEDS: tuple[int, ...] = tuple(range(1_000_000, 1_000_020))`
- **Invariants:** 20 seeds, disjoint from training seeds `[0, 10⁶)` and from `FINAL_SEEDS` (TRAIN-04)
- **Used by:** train, evaluate

### core.FINAL_SEEDS: Final evaluation seeds
`FINAL_SEEDS: tuple[int, ...] = tuple(range(2_000_000, 2_000_100))`
- **Invariants:** 100 seeds, shared by every run, baseline and reference (EVAL-03, CHECK-02)
- **Used by:** evaluate, refcheck

## worlds

### worlds.make: World factory
`def make(world: str, variant: str = "default", **overrides: int | float) -> World`
- **Invariants:** worlds `snake` (`default`), `fish` (`one`, `many`, `local`), `prey` (`default`), `check-discrete`, `check-continuous`; `overrides` change only the spec's starting values (grid size, counts, step limits; spec Assumptions)
- **Errors:** `ValueError` naming an unknown world, variant or override
- **Used by:** train, evaluate, replay, refcheck, baselines

### worlds.CheckWorld: type
`class CheckWorld(World, Protocol): def states(self) -> Array; def best_actions(self) -> Array`
- **Invariants:** `states()` is the observation of every check-world state, `n × obs_len`; `best_actions()` the hand-derived best action for each, to within 0.1 per dimension for `Box` actions
- **Boundary:** train · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/worlds.CheckWorld/ · **Cases:** a replay double of the 6-state corridor; one of the 1-D target point
- **Used by:** train

## baselines

### baselines.RandomPolicy: Uniform random play
`class RandomPolicy(Policy): def __init__(self, action: ActionSpace) -> None`
- **Invariants:** each action drawn uniformly from the declared action format (EVAL-01), using only the `rng` passed to `act`
- **Used by:** train, evaluate, replay

### baselines.RulePolicy: type
`class RulePolicy(Policy, Protocol): description: str`
- **Invariants:** acts on observations only; `description` is the world's one sentence (EVAL-02)
- **Boundary:** evaluate, replay, cli · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/baselines.RulePolicy/ · **Cases:** a replay double of the snake rule over 5 observations; the fish rule seeing no ball
- **Used by:** evaluate, replay, cli

### baselines.rule_for: Rule baseline lookup
`def rule_for(world: str, variant: str, team: str) -> RulePolicy`
- **Invariants:** SNAKE-07, FISH-09 and PREY-07 rules; deterministic except FISH-09's and PREY-07's random fallbacks, which use the `rng` passed to `act`
- **Errors:** `KeyError` naming a world, variant or team with no rule
- **Used by:** train, evaluate, replay

## methods

### methods.MethodConfig: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class MethodConfig: method: Literal["dqn", "ppo"]; settings: Settings`
- **Invariants:** `settings` holds only keys the method declares; missing keys take the method's defaults, written back in full to the run record
- **Boundary:** train, runlog, refcheck · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/methods.MethodConfig/ · **Cases:** snake DQN defaults; PPO with one overridden learning rate
- **Used by:** train, runlog, refcheck

### methods.Transition: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class Transition: obs: Array; actions: Array; rewards: Array; next_obs: Array; done: bool; truncated: bool; active: Array`
- **Invariants:** rows are the team's agents in `TeamSpec.agents` order; `active` masks agents that had already left before this step
- **Boundary:** train · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/methods.Transition/ · **Cases:** a snake transition; a many-fish transition of 8 agents
- **Used by:** train

### methods.Learner: type
```python
class Learner(Protocol):
    def act(self, obs: Array, rng: np.random.Generator) -> Array: ...   # exploring
    def observe(self, t: Transition) -> None: ...                       # updates on its own schedule
    def policy(self) -> Policy: ...                                      # frozen, deterministic copy
    def state_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]: ...
```
- **Invariants:** hand-written learning code only (CHECK-01); `policy()` is greedy (DQN) or the mean action (PPO) and does not change as the learner trains
- **Errors:** `observe` raises `NonFiniteError(value: float)` when a loss or parameter is NaN or infinite, before changing any parameter
- **Boundary:** train · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/methods.Learner/ · **Cases:** a replay double of a DQN learner over 10 snake transitions
- **Used by:** train

### methods.make_learner: Learner factory
`def make_learner(config: MethodConfig, spec: WorldSpec, team: str, rng: np.random.Generator) -> Learner`
- **Invariants:** `dqn` needs a `Discrete` action space and `ppo` a `Box` one
- **Errors:** `ValueError` naming the method and the action format on a mismatch
- **Used by:** train

### methods.load_policy: Checkpoint to policy
`def load_policy(ckpt: Checkpoint, team: str, spec: WorldSpec) -> Policy`
- **Invariants:** the same checkpoint and team give a policy that acts identically every time
- **Errors:** `SpecMismatchError` naming each differing field (observation length, action format) when `ckpt.spec` doesn't match `spec` (REPLAY edge case)
- **Boundary:** evaluate, replay · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/methods.load_policy/ · **Cases:** a fake returning the snake rule policy for any snake checkpoint
- **Used by:** evaluate, replay

## train

### train.RunConfig: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class RunConfig: name: str; world: str; variant: str; methods: Mapping[str, MethodConfig]; seed: int; budget: int; check_settings: Mapping[str, Settings]; device: str = "cpu"`
- **Invariants:** `methods` has one entry per team (TRAIN-07); `budget` counts world steps, not agent steps; `check_settings` overrides settings for the check world only (AD-09)
- **Boundary:** runlog, refcheck, cli · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/train.RunConfig/ · **Cases:** a snake config from `configs/snake-default.toml`; a predator-prey config with two methods
- **Used by:** runlog, refcheck, cli

### train.run: One training run
`def run(config: RunConfig, root: Path) -> RunRecord`
- **Invariants:** exactly `budget` world steps (TRAIN-01); checkpoints at 0%, 10%, … 100% (TRAIN-03); evaluation of every team on `EVAL_SEEDS` at every 5% (TRAIN-04); same config on the same machine → identical logs and checkpoints (TRAIN-02)
- **Errors:** `RunExistsError` before any work if the run folder exists; `NonFiniteError` ends the run as `failed` with step and value, keeping the last good checkpoint; interruption marks it `incomplete`
- **Used by:** train.run_batch, cli

### train.run_batch: Parallel runs
`def run_batch(configs: Sequence[RunConfig], root: Path, *, workers: int | None = None) -> list[RunRecord]`
- **Invariants:** first runs `check_method` for each team's method and settings; then one process per config, up to `workers` (default: the core count), each with one torch thread (TRAIN-05, AD-05)
- **Errors:** `CheckFailedError(result: CheckResult)` before any run starts; a failing run doesn't stop the others
- **Used by:** cli

### train.CheckResult: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class CheckResult: method: str; world: str; agreement: float; passed: bool`
- **Invariants:** `agreement` is the share of check-world states where the trained policy picks the best action; `passed` is `agreement >= 0.95` (TRAIN-06)
- **Boundary:** cli · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/train.CheckResult/ · **Cases:** a passing DQN check; a failing PPO check at 0.80
- **Used by:** cli

### train.check_method: Check-world gate
`def check_method(config: MethodConfig, seed: int) -> CheckResult`
- **Invariants:** trains on the method's check world (`check-discrete` for `dqn`, `check-continuous` for `ppo`) for its fixed check budget; under a minute on the laptop
- **Used by:** train.run_batch, cli

## runlog

### runlog.RunRecord: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class RunRecord: config: RunConfig; spec: WorldSpec; started: datetime; ended: datetime | None; status: Literal["running", "finished", "incomplete", "failed"]; failure: Failure | None; path: Path`
`Failure(step: int, value: float, checkpoint: Path)`
- **Invariants:** every LOG-01 field present once the run ends; `config.methods` holds full settings, defaults included
- **Boundary:** train, evaluate, charts, refcheck, cli · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/runlog.RunRecord/ · **Cases:** a finished snake run; a failed run with a NaN at step 41,200; an incomplete run
- **Used by:** train, evaluate, charts, refcheck, cli

### runlog.EvalPoint: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class EvalPoint: step: int; scores: Mapping[str, float]; measures: Mapping[str, float]`
- **Invariants:** means over the 20 `EVAL_SEEDS` episodes, per team and per measure; a finished run has 21, at 0%, 5%, … 100% (TRAIN-04)
- **Boundary:** charts, evaluate, cli · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/runlog.EvalPoint/ · **Cases:** snake point at 50%; predator-prey point with both teams
- **Used by:** charts, evaluate, cli

### runlog.Checkpoint: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class Checkpoint: run: str; pct: int; step: int; spec: WorldSpec; methods: Mapping[str, MethodConfig]; state: Mapping[str, dict[str, object]]; path: Path`
- **Invariants:** `pct` in {0, 10, …, 100}; `state` keyed by team; saved and loaded through `torch.save`/`torch.load(weights_only=True)`
- **Boundary:** methods, evaluate, replay · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/runlog.Checkpoint/ · **Cases:** the 0% and 100% checkpoints of a short snake run
- **Used by:** methods, evaluate, replay

### runlog.Run: type
```python
class Run(Protocol):
    record: RunRecord
    def episodes(self) -> list[EpisodeResult]: ...
    def evals(self) -> list[EvalPoint]: ...
    def checkpoints(self) -> list[Checkpoint]: ...
```
- **Invariants:** read-only view of one run folder; readable while the run writes (LOG-06)
- **Boundary:** charts, evaluate, replay, refcheck, cli · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/runlog.Run/ · **Cases:** a replay double of a finished 3-checkpoint snake run folder
- **Used by:** charts, evaluate, replay, refcheck, cli

### runlog.RunWriter: Run folder writer
```python
class RunWriter:
    def __init__(self, root: Path, config: RunConfig, spec: WorldSpec) -> None: ...
    def episode(self, result: EpisodeResult) -> None: ...
    def eval(self, point: EvalPoint) -> None: ...      # flushes every log
    def checkpoint(self, pct: int, step: int, state: Mapping[str, dict[str, object]]) -> Checkpoint: ...
    def close(self, status: str, failure: Failure | None = None) -> RunRecord: ...
```
- **Errors:** `RunExistsError` naming the path if `runs/<world>/<variant>/<name>` exists (TRAIN edge case)
- **Used by:** train

### runlog.find_runs: Run lookup
`def find_runs(root: Path, world: str, variant: str, *, include: Sequence[str] = ()) -> list[Run]`
- **Invariants:** finished runs only, plus incomplete or failed runs named in `include` (TRAIN edge case); a `running` run with no live process is reported as incomplete
- **Used by:** charts, evaluate, refcheck, cli

### runlog.Progress: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class Progress: step: int; budget: int; latest: EvalPoint | None; elapsed: timedelta; status: str`
- **Invariants:** at most one evaluation point behind the run (LOG-06)
- **Boundary:** cli · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/runlog.Progress/ · **Cases:** a run at 35% with the 35% point written
- **Used by:** cli

### runlog.progress: Live run view
`def progress(path: Path) -> Progress`
- **Errors:** `FileNotFoundError` if no run is at `path`
- **Used by:** cli

## charts

### charts.learning_curve: Learning-curve chart
`def learning_curve(runs: Sequence[Run], baselines: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, float]], out: Path, *, measure: str | None = None) -> Path`
- **Invariants:** `baselines` is team → {"random", "rule"} mean score; draws per team a mean line, a min–max band and both baseline lines against "environment steps" (LOG-03, PREY-10), or a declared measure the same way (LOG-05); follows the `dataviz` skill (LOG-04); under 3 runs, titled with the count and a band note
- **Errors:** `MixedRunsError` naming the differing settings when runs differ by more than seed
- **Used by:** cli

### charts.pairing_heatmap: Pairing-grid chart
`def pairing_heatmap(grid: PairingGrid, out: Path) -> Path`
- **Invariants:** one 12 × 12 heatmap per team, prey checkpoints on one axis and predator checkpoints on the other; follows the `dataviz` skill
- **Used by:** cli

## evaluate

### evaluate.Comparison: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class Comparison: baseline: Literal["random", "rule"]; team: str; learned_mean: float; baseline_mean: float; difference: float; p_raw: float; p_holm: float; rejected: bool`
- **Invariants:** `difference` is signed so positive means better in the team's direction
- **Boundary:** refcheck, cli · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/evaluate.Comparison/ · **Cases:** a rejected snake-vs-random; a kept snake-vs-rule
- **Used by:** evaluate.Summary

### evaluate.compare: Paired permutation test
`def compare(learned: Array, baseline: Array, direction: Direction, *, permutations: int = 10_000, rng: np.random.Generator) -> tuple[float, float]`
- **Invariants:** `learned` is runs × seeds, averaged over runs per seed; `baseline` has one score per seed, on the same seeds; swaps labels within each seed; returns (difference, one-sided p) as EVAL-04 states; built and checked with the `null-hypothesis-testing` skill
- **Errors:** `ValueError` if seed counts differ
- **Used by:** evaluate.final_evaluation

### evaluate.Summary: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class Summary: world: str; variant: str; team: str; runs: tuple[str, ...]; learned_mean: float; learned_range: tuple[float, float]; run_means: Mapping[str, float]; random_mean: float; rule_mean: float; comparisons: tuple[Comparison, ...]; verdict: Verdict; collapse: int | None`
`Verdict(beats_baselines: bool, failing_runs: tuple[str, ...], runs_needed: int)`
- **Invariants:** one per world, variant and team (EVAL-06, PREY-08); `comparisons` empty and `runs_needed > 0` with fewer than 5 runs; `collapse` is the first step of a flagged collapse (Risks)
- **Boundary:** charts, refcheck, cli · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/evaluate.Summary/ · **Cases:** a passing snake summary; one with a failing run; one with 3 runs
- **Used by:** refcheck, cli

### evaluate.final_evaluation: Final evaluation
`def final_evaluation(runs: Sequence[Run], out: Path, *, workers: int | None = None) -> list[Summary]`
- **Invariants:** plays every final checkpoint and both baselines on `FINAL_SEEDS` (EVAL-03); Holm across the 2 comparisons per team; a pass needs both nulls rejected (EVAL-04) and every run's mean beating the rule mean (EVAL-05); in predator-prey each team plays against the rule-based opponent (PREY-08); within 10 minutes (QR-05)
- **Used by:** refcheck, cli

### evaluate.PairingGrid: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class PairingGrid: run: str; prey_pcts: tuple[int, ...]; predator_pcts: tuple[int, ...]; scores: Mapping[str, Array]`
- **Invariants:** `scores` keyed by team, each 12 × 12, cell [i, j] the mean of 20 `EVAL_SEEDS` episodes of prey checkpoint i against predator checkpoint j (PREY-09)
- **Boundary:** charts · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/evaluate.PairingGrid/ · **Cases:** a 12 × 12 grid with planted values
- **Used by:** charts

### evaluate.pairing_grid: Checkpoint pairings
`def pairing_grid(run: Run, *, workers: int | None = None) -> PairingGrid`
- **Errors:** `ValueError` if the run's world doesn't have exactly two teams
- **Used by:** cli

## replay

### replay.Trace: type
`@dataclass(frozen=True) class Trace: label: str; spec: WorldSpec; seed: int; frames: tuple[Frame, ...]; hit_step_limit: bool`
- **Invariants:** same sources and seed → equal frames (REPLAY-02); `label` names the checkpoint or baseline per team
- **Boundary:** replay · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/replay.Trace/ · **Cases:** the rule snake on seed 7
- **Used by:** replay.view, replay.save_video

### replay.trace: Re-simulate an episode
`def trace(world: str, variant: str, sources: Mapping[str, Checkpoint | Literal["random", "rule"]], seed: int) -> Trace`
- **Invariants:** `sources` keyed by team; a team left out takes its policy from the first checkpoint given, so one predator-prey checkpoint replays both teams; any checkpoint and seed (REPLAY-01, REPLAY-06, PREY-09)
- **Errors:** `SpecMismatchError` from `methods.load_policy`, naming the mismatch (REPLAY edge case)
- **Used by:** cli

### replay.view: Replay window
`def view(traces: Sequence[Trace], *, overlay_sight: bool = False) -> None`
- **Invariants:** one or two traces side by side, stepping in sync, a finished trace holding its last frame (REPLAY-04); pause, step ±1 and 0.25×/1×/4×/16× where 1× is 30 steps/s (REPLAY-03, QR-04); step, scores and rewards shown (REPLAY-05); a sight toggle when `spec.sight` is set (REPLAY-08); "stopped at step limit" shown when `hit_step_limit`
- **Errors:** `ValueError` for more than two traces
- **Used by:** cli

### replay.save_video: Replay to MP4
`def save_video(trace: Trace, out: Path, *, overlay_sight: bool = False) -> Path`
- **Invariants:** the whole episode at 1× (30 frames/s) as H.264 MP4 that plays in a standard player (REPLAY-07); offline (QR-06)
- **Used by:** cli

I've written the architecture and the package contract as Drafts, and they're ready for your review. Lint reports 0 errors, and `dt status` shows no uncovered, changed or stale requirements. All 76 requirements have a component.

**Files**
- `docs/architecture.md`: one package, `rllab`, with 12 components and decisions AD-01 to AD-09.
- `docs/packages/rllab/contract.md`: the public functions and types of every component, with the test fixtures and sample cases each one needs.

**Shape: one package.** It's one person, one laptop, one install, and nothing deployed. The only part that could split off later is `refcheck`. It's the only component that uses Stable-Baselines3 and Gymnasium, and it installs as an optional `check` extra.

**Components:** `core` (world/policy interfaces, seed sets, the one episode loop) → `worlds`, `baselines`, `methods`, `runlog` → `train`, `evaluate`, `replay`, `charts`, `refcheck` → `notes`, `cli`.

**Decisions that need your attention**
- **Shape and contract size.** The lint warns that the contract is 396 lines, over its 200-line ceiling, and suggests splitting the package. I recommend keeping one package: a long contract alone isn't a reason to split, because each task loads only the sections it reads. The alternative is to move `refcheck`, or the shared core, into its own package now. **Default: stay single.**
- **AD-03, learning methods.** DQN for snake and PPO for fish and predator-prey. All agents on a team share one learner, and each team has its own. Evaluation and replays use the agent's best action, with no exploration.
- **AD-08, reference check for predator-prey.** Stable-Baselines3 can't train two teams at once, so its reference trains each team against the rule-based opponent. That makes the 80% bar a comparison of different setups in that world.
- **AD-09, method check before each batch.** Every batch first trains the method on a tiny check world, adding under a minute. The batch is refused if the method misses the 95% bar.

No decision needs an API probe: there are no external APIs or datasets, only libraries.

**ASSUMPTIONS**
- The world interface is my own design, not Gymnasium or PettingZoo. Steps use arrays indexed by agent, and teams map to agent indices.
- "Not seen" is stored as a 0/1 flag followed by zeros, so observation lengths stay fixed.
- Rule baselines act on observations only. For the snake rule, that means the observation holds the food's offset in cells.
- The training budget counts world steps, not one step per agent. 1× replay speed is 30 steps per second.
- Seed ranges: training seeds are below 10⁶, in-training evaluation uses 1,000,000–1,000,019, and final evaluation uses 2,000,000–2,000,099.
- Run storage: each run gets a folder `runs/<world>/<variant>/<name>/` holding `run.json`, JSON Lines logs, and `.pt` checkpoints.
- For lower-is-better scores, a reference-check pass is a hand-to-reference ratio between 2/3 and 1.25.
- `cli` uses `argparse`, and settings come from TOML files in `configs/`.

**Open questions (listed under Risks in the doc)**
1. Is the predator-prey reference check (AD-08) good enough, or should the hand-written team also train against the fixed opponent for that check?
2. What counts as a collapse? I assumed a team is flagged when its score stays at or below its random baseline's mean for the last 4 or more evaluation points.
3. Can many-fish and predator-prey train within 60 minutes? The first fish build will time it. Five parallel runs may also land partly on the slower efficiency cores (QR-02).

The lint also warns that `dataviz`, named on the roadmap's Skills lines, isn't installed in this project or the plugin.

Do you approve the architecture, or would you like changes?
